what: UK-based Etsy seller reports that on November 6, 2025, their daily sales dropped from £1,200 per day to £20 and that Etsy support dismissed the issue as an SEO problem.
verbatim_snippet: "On the 6th of November, our sales went from 1.2k per day, to £20 -Etsy support were no help, stating it was just our SEO. It was clear that it wasn't, as we just weren't visible in search. Our shop name wasn't coming up, nada."
